issue_title: Streamline ATA event navigation into two branded bars
problem_statement:
Streamline ATA event navigation into two branded bars

The owner approved replacing the three-row All Things AI event header with two rows, then explicitly requested deployment on 2026-09-14.

Acceptance criteria:
- White parent bar with parent navigation, search, Help and account controls.
- Event identity and right-aligned event navigation in the second row; the All Things AI Orbit bar remains dark.
- Past events and Past speakers are available under the top Events menu, and are no longer automatically appended to event navigation.
- Existing ConferenceOS navigation configuration governs order, visibility, intentionally empty menus, and explicitly configured archive links across tenants, desktop and mobile.
- Dropdowns fit within the viewport and remain usable by keyboard and touch.
- Deploy only this header delta to the ATA install; no canonical release, schema or secret changes.

Intentional test retirement: three prior named tests asserted automatic archive-link append behavior. That behavior was explicitly removed by the owner. Two component cases were replaced with assertions that no archive links are injected, and the obsolete pure append helper/test was removed. New editor-driven tests cover custom archive links, hidden items, order and an intentionally empty override in both visual templates, including actual navigation URL validation. The tests were not removed to hide a failure.

Final local verification on the reviewed commit: all 9,224 tests pass (765 files, 15 existing todos), TypeScript/build/security pass, ESLint zero errors, 34 responsive browser cases pass, header axe has zero violations, and local Lighthouse accessibility is 100 for mobile/desktop. Hosted checks and exact-head review are tracked on the pull request.
